fields.description: Nothing is checked until this is on.
fields.label: Enable NIF Validation

fields.description: Warn shows a message and lets the save through. Block refuses the save.
fields.label: Enforcement

fields.description: Only check when the NIF or the customer type is new or changed. Leave on: without it, every save of an existing record with a bad NIF is blocked, including edits that have nothing to do with the NIF. Use the report to clean up history instead.
fields.label: Only Validate New or Changed Values

fields.description: When the NIF is valid for the other type, correct the Customer Type on save instead of complaining. Only ever applied when the number itself is unambiguous, never guessed.
fields.label: Auto-correct Customer Type

fields.description: A customer with no NIF at all is not flagged.
fields.label: Allow Blank NIF

fields.description: One per line. Accepted as-is, whatever the format. 999999999 is the usual consumidor final placeholder.
fields.label: Exempt NIFs

fields.description: Accepted first digits for a 10-digit company NIF. Current law (Decreto Presidencial 245/21, art. 5) assigns 5. 7 was the earlier prefix for collective entities, converted to Type 5 on 1 August 2019, and 0 appears on pre-2019 sequential numbers — both are still on live records, so both are accepted by default. Set this to 5 alone to insist on re-registered numbers.
fields.label: Accepted First Digits
